meta.titulo: Tríplice · Three border markets, one store
meta.descripcion: Marketplace for Paraguay, Brazil and Argentina: prices in your currency, stores from Ciudad del Este, Foz do Iguaçu and Puerto Iguazú, and reviews from local buyers.

comun.avisoDemo: Tríplice is a demo store: products, sellers, reviews and payments are not real.

inicio.bajada: Stores from Ciudad del Este, Foz do Iguaçu and Puerto Iguazú. Prices in your currency and reviews from people who live here.
inicio.confianza1: Compare each seller's price, rating and delivery time on the same page.
inicio.confianza2: See guaraníes, reais, pesos or dollars at today's rate. Change it at the top anytime.
inicio.confianza3: Written by buyers from all three countries, in their own language. Verified purchases carry a badge.

reputacion.consejoTitulo: What would raise your number the most

consejos.opiniones: Read the 1 to 3 star reviews: it is almost always the same complaint.
consejos.a_tiempo: Promise the preparation time you can actually keep: a slightly longer, kept promise beats a short, broken one.
consejos.devoluciones: Test items before handing them over and show what is in the box in your photos.
consejos.respondidas: Answer the pending questions: every one counts.
consejos.respuesta: Answer questions within the first hour: for a shopper it is the difference between buying from you or leaving.

form.fichaAyuda: These are the search filters: fill in what you know.
form.categoriaAyuda: It defines the specifications and the search filters.
form.marcaAyuda: If it has no brand, write “Genérica”.
form.tituloAyuda: The way someone would search for it: what it is and what makes it different.
form.otrosIdiomas: Name and description in Portuguese and English
form.otrosIdiomasAyuda: Optional: if left empty, the Spanish text is shown.
form.vinetasAyuda: Up to 6 lines. Shown next to the photos.
form.ejesAyuda: Tick up to two. If the product only comes one way, leave them all unticked.
form.precio: Price in US dollars, before tax
form.precioAyuda: US$ with a dot or comma for cents. Each country’s taxes are added automatically.
form.listaAyuda: Optional. Only if it is discounted.
form.fotosAyuda: Up to 4. We resize them to 1,200 px, strip location data and convert them to WebP.
form.fotosHeredadas: No photos of its own: it uses the first variant’s.
form.vistaPreviaAyuda: With each country’s tax for this category.
form.preparacionAyuda: This is your promise. Taking longer lowers your reputation (on-time deliveries).
form.peso: Weight with the box, in grams
form.pesoAyuda: To calculate shipping. Leave it empty if you do not know.
form.resumenErrores: {n, plural, one {Check one field before saving:} other {Check # fields before saving:}}
form.ajeno: Another store listed this product. You set your own price, stock and whether you sell it; the name, photos and specifications are edited by the store that listed it.
form.demoFotos: Preview without Supabase: photos are kept in the server’s memory and wiped when it restarts.

errores.categoria: Choose the product’s category: the specifications depend on it.
errores.titulo: Write the product name, 8 to 120 characters, the way someone would search for it.
errores.titulo_largo: The name can be up to 120 characters: shorten it a little.
errores.marca: Enter the brand, 2 to 40 characters. If it has none, write “Genérica”.
errores.descripcion: The description can be up to 2,000 characters: shorten it a little.
errores.vinetas: Up to 6 lines of 120 characters each.
errores.garantia: Warranty is in whole months, from 0 to 60.
errores.peso: Weight is in grams, with no dots or commas: for example, 1250.
errores.preparacion: Enter how many hours you need to get it ready, from 1 to 240.
errores.condicion: Choose whether it is new, refurbished or used.
errores.ejes: Choose up to two ways the variants differ.
errores.variantes: There must be between 1 and 20 variants.
errores.precio: Enter the price in US dollars before tax, for example 29.90.
errores.lista: The previous price must be higher than the current one. If it is not discounted, leave it empty.
errores.stock: Stock is a whole number from 0 to 99,999. Enter 0 if you have none right now.
errores.opcion: Fill this in, or untick it above if the variants do not differ in this.
errores.repetida: Another variant is identical: change one of the options or remove one of them.
errores.numero: Use numbers, with a dot or comma for decimals: for example, 1.7.
errores.fotos_faltan: Upload at least one photo: it is the cover in the store and in search results.
errores.foto_tipo: That is not a photo. Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP file.
errores.foto_grande: One of the photos is larger than 8 MB. Choose another or take it at a lower resolution.
errores.foto_muchas: Up to 4 photos per variant: remove some.
errores.foto_ilegible: We could not open one of the photos. Try another or take it again.
errores.foto_ajena: That photo is not from your store. Upload it again from your computer or phone.
errores.suspendida: Your store is suspended: you can still change prices and stock on what you already sell, but you can't publish or edit listings. Contact support to reactivate it.
errores.servidor: We could not save because of a problem on our side. Try again in a moment: what you wrote is still here.
errores.no_existe: That product is no longer one of yours. Go back to the list and choose it again.

vacio.por_preparar: No orders waiting to be started. When one comes in, it shows up here with its deadline.

pedidos.otras: It also has items from another store: the shopper sees it on its way once both have shipped.
pedidos.avanzado: Done: order {numero} is now “{estado}”. The shopper already sees it in their order.
pedidos.mas: Showing the 60 most recent in this group.

errores.orden: That order had already moved forward (did you change it in another tab?). Here is how it stands now.
errores.cerrado: That order is closed: it cannot move forward.
errores.no_existe: That order has no items from your store.
errores.servidor: We could not save the change. Try again in a moment.

preguntas.respondida: Done: your answer is on the product page.

errores.limite: You answered many in a row: wait a few minutes and try again.
